{{Quote|The m'iiyoom is the white flower that blossoms in the season of trine, the season when all three moons give their light. It's also called the nightlily.|M'iiyoom Onith explains her namesake|audio=Miiyoom-Nightlily.flac|<ref name="audio">[[Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale (audio drama)|"Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale" audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''M'iiyoom Onith''', {{C|{{Audio|MiiyoomOnith-Nightlily.flac|Pronunciation}}}} also known as '''Nightlily''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]]. She spent her life on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] until she was selected to travel [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and find a mate from outside of her culture. During her journeys, she ran out of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and became stranded in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where she was courted by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] tax collector [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]]. Trevagg found Onith physically intoxicating and intended to desert her after a single night of passion, but won her affection by falsely proposing to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] her. Onith in turn fell in love with Trevagg, believing he had agreed to partake in her species' [[H'nemthe mating ritual|mating ritual]]: she would [[Death/Legends|kill]] him immediately after the [[Reproduction/Legends|reproductive act]].

After Trevagg showed her some of the sights of Mos Eisley, he brought her to a [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and ordered her several [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drinks. The two then went to the [[Mos Eisley Inn]]. As per H'nemthe custom, Onith used her razor-sharp [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] to eviscerate Trevagg immediately after they consummated their attraction. She soon after returned to her homeworld. Notorious for being the first female of her [[Species/Legends|species]] to attempt mating with a non-H'nemthe, she began speaking publicly about her experience.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I can't believe that you would&hellip; would truly love me enough to wed. The males of my species&hellip; fear that commitment. That giving of all for love.''"<br />"''The males of your species are fools.|M'iiyoom Onith and Feltipern Trevagg, misunderstanding the other's intentions|<ref name="nightlily" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] M'iiyoom Onith was born to an unwealthy family on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of her [[Species/Legends|species]]. She was named for the [[m'iiyoom]], a white [[Plant/Legends|flower]] that blossomed on the planet and that translated from the [[H'nemthe (language)/Legends|H'nemthe]] to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] as "Nightlily." Onith lived with her mother and sisters, and because virgins were forbidden to leave H'nemthe, she remained on the planet<ref name="nightlily" /> until she was selected to take part in an experiment to see how well female H'nemthe would fare at finding [[Reproduction/Legends|mates]] from outside of their native culture.<ref name="negtas">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Onith left to visit her sister on [[Cona/Legends|Cona]],<ref name="nightlily" /> and was accompanied by a chaperone during her travels until she boarded the wrong [[Starship/Legends|ship]] during a layover at a [[Space station/Legends|transfer station]]. The [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Mammon Hoole]] later believed that she may have done this intentionally in order to lose her chaperone.<ref name="negtas" />

[[File:Drinkup.png|thumb|left|230px|M'iiyoom Onith flirts with Feltipern Trevagg in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.]]
Before reaching Cona,<ref name="audio" /> Onith ended up in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where officials claimed that her travel papers were not in order.<ref name="nightlily" /> Although the discrepancy was questionable,<ref name="CSWE" /> she was forced to pay a passage tax and was unable to afford transportation back to her homeworld.<ref name="nightlily" /> Onith lingered in Mos Eisley for several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], becoming a regular at a [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|local cantina]].<ref name="blues">{{StoryCite|story=Empire Blues: The Devaronian's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref><ref name="hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#22: M'iiyoom Onith (H'nemthe)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TAC22Miiyoom.asp}}</ref> Eventually, she made her way to a tax collector's office in the city and was directed to the male [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]]. When she entered Trevagg's office, the Gotal glimpsed her and immediately desired her. In order to keep her on Tatooine for the night, he told Onith that he would speak to the captain of the [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] the ''[[Tellivar Lady]]'', but in reality dawdled on his way to [[Docking Bay 9]], allowing the ship to lift off. Trevagg then took Onith to lunch at [[Court of the Fountain/Legends|Court of the Fountain]], an expensive restaurant owned by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="nightlily" /> While walking there from the tax office, he offered many compliments on her appearance, flattering her and winning some affection in return.<ref name="audio" />

Jabba the Hutt's chef [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] produced four courses of [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] and vegetables for Onith, as H'nemthe virgins were not permitted to eat meat. Trevagg claimed to have feelings for her while only intending to have one night together and viewing her as naive prey. Onith interpreted his declaration as a brave proposal to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] her and engage in her species' [[H'nemthe mating ritual|mating ritual]], in which she would immediately [[Death/Legends|kill]] him; in truth, he was ignorant of it.<ref name="nightlily" /> The Gotal played along, kissing Onith, and promising her a union of body and soul.<ref name="audio" />

Trevagg brought her back to his office and booked her passage from Tatooine on the passenger liner the ''[[Starswan]]''. She hoped he would come with her to her homeworld and marry her before her mother and sisters, but he claimed he could not leave for a few days. He then brought her to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] she had visited several weeks before and continued lowering her inhibitions. Onith was excited at the prospect of marriage and happily followed Trevagg to the bar,<ref name="nightlily" /> where he identified various species to her astonished [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="audio" />

[[File:Loversdrink.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Onith and Trevagg at the cantina]]
The two sat at a booth with the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] [[Elis Helrot/Legends|Elis Helrot]]<ref name="givin">{{DB|species|givin|Givin}}</ref> but paid him little mind.<ref name="audio" /> Onith and Trevagg discussed consummating their marriage immediately, and she was in awe that he was prepared to make that sacrifice for her. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the young [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] then entered the cantina, and Onith became frightened when the two skirmished with the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] and his companion [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]]. Trevagg used the opportunity to fetch her another drink with a [[Love-Wallop pill]] in it. When the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], Onith again grew frightened<ref name="nightlily" /> and asked if they could leave.<ref name="audio" />

Trevagg brought her to the [[Mos Eisley Inn]].<ref name="nightlily" /> Onith had fallen madly in love with him,<ref name="negtas" /> and they began to physically demonstrate their passion for one another.<ref name="audio" /> After they had sex, Onith used her razor-sharp [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] to gut Trevagg in accordance with custom and left his corpse at the inn.<ref name="nightlily" /> She remained stranded on Tatooine<ref name="CSWE" /> but eventually returned to her homeworld and gained notoriety for being the first female of her species to attempt mating with a non-H'nemthe. She had also become free to travel offworld but preferred to remain on the planet and speak publicly about her experience.<ref name="negtas" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Mating is such a solemn thing, such an awe-inspiring thing&hellip;|M'iiyoom Onith|audio=HnemtheMating-Nightlily.flac|<ref name="audio" />}}
M'iiyoom Onith came from a culture that placed a premium on true love.<ref name="negtas" /> While being courted by Feltipern Trevagg, who only desired her physically, she was swayed by his charms<ref name="nightlily" /> and fell madly in love with him.<ref name="negtas" /> She was also excited at the prospect of marrying him after having only known him for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. After consuming some alcohol, she desired to mate with him,<ref name="nightlily" /> which in H'nemthe culture only occurred in cases of true love.<ref name="negtas" /> Trevagg surmised from her conversation skills and her inability to see through his lies that she was unintelligent, which would make it easier to manipulate her; instead, he was ignorant that he had agreed to let her kill him.<ref name="nightlily" />

After having lived her entire life on her homeworld, Onith was enchanted by many of the sights that she saw in Mos Eisley, including the Court of the Fountain restaurant,<ref name="nightlily" /> the cantina that she and Trevagg visited, and the many species present in the city. She was shy and modest, denying Trevagg's claims that she was beautiful and only mentioning her virginity bashfully.<ref name="audio" /> Additionally, Onith was quick to frighten, and was uneasy entering the cantina,<ref name="nightlily" /> wary of the dark thoughts and emotions within.<ref name="audio" /> She relaxed when Trevagg promised her safety, however, as she felt completely comfortable in the presence of the Gotal. Onith had green eyes,<ref name="nightlily" /> green skin, a beak-like [[Nose/Legends|snout]] and a razor-sharp tongue.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|When we first saw Feltiperrn in the cantina, he was snuggling up to a beak-nosed alien who was giggling up a storm. Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, of course, but this comely alien was given the unflattering on-set nickname of Yam Nose.|Author [[Pablo Hidalgo]], discussing the creation of M'iiyoom Onith|<ref name="shedding">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>}}
M'iiyoom Onith first appeared as a background [[Alien/Legends|alien]] in the cantina scene of [[George Lucas]]'s [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'']],<ref name="anh">{{Film|IV}}</ref> portrayed by the young animator [[Phil Tippett]]<ref name="Tom Spina Tippett Confirmation">{{DMCite|dm=File:TrevaggAndOnith.png|creator=[[Tom Spina]]|date=2021-08-31}}</ref> and seen snuggling up to the Gotal character Feltipern Trevagg. Onith was one of the scene's booth-dwelling aliens whose masks were designed by makeup artist [[Rick Baker]],<ref name="shedding" /> created for supplemental shooting done during post-production when Lucas decided to liven the scene with more action and additional characters.<ref name="beastmaster">{{InsiderCite|126|The Beastmaster!}}</ref>

[[File:Fumanchu03.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Onith's mask was designed by makeup artist Rick Baker.]]
Given the on-set nickname of Yam Nose, Onith was intended to receive the proper name of "Yamnoss," but the idea never saw the light of day.<ref name="shedding" /> However, a H'nemthe character in [[1978]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' that re-used Onith's mask was eventually dubbed [[Yamnoss]].<ref name="Who's Who">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-holiday-special-cantina-we-may-not-thrive-friend-but-we-survive-friend|text=''The Star Wars Holiday Special'' Cantina: Who's Who|int=The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who|nolive=1}}</ref> Onith's mask was also re-used for a [[Unidentified H'nemthe|H'nemthe character]] that appeared in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="shedding" />

Onith's name was established in [[1995]] with the release of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'s [[Premiere Limited]] set.<ref name="cardgame">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=M'iiyoom Onith}}</ref> Her character was fleshed out by author [[Barbara Hambly]] in the short story ''[[Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale]]'', which was included in the [[1995]] anthology ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]''.<ref name="nightlily" /> [[Ashley Albert]] voiced the character in the [[Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale (audio drama)|audio drama]] of ''Nightlily''.<ref name="audio" /> Onith also appears as one of several cantina aliens in a [[1979]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Friends|drunk-driving PSA]] set in the Mos Eisley Cantina.<ref name="Don't drive drunk">''[[Star Friends]]''</ref>

Although Onith appears in the [[Star Wars Manga: A New Hope 2|manga adaptation]] of ''Star Wars'', she is standing with a group of assorted aliens rather than sitting with Trevagg and Elis Helrot.<ref name="manga">[[Star Wars Manga: A New Hope 2|''Star Wars Manga: A New Hope'' 2]]</ref> The cover of ''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'' depicts the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Muftak/Legends|Muftak]] sitting at the booth with Onith and Trevagg, and its interior shows a table populated by Onith, a Rodian, and an Aqualish.<ref name="popup">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]''</ref>
